title: Agentic Business Processes
readerIntent: Design controlled AI planning and execution over Nodics capabilities.
priorKnowledge: Understand Assistant tools, target APIs, confirmations, and workflows.
owner: Assistant plans; target modules execute; Workflow owns durable multi-step process state
summary: Agentic behavior discovers allowlisted contracts, proposes bounded actions, obtains required approval, and delegates execution without self-authorizing or bypassing business workflows.

sections.heading: Controlled loop
items: Interpret user intent within an approved Assistant definition.
Discover current allowed operation metadata, never arbitrary URLs or code.
Retrieve permission-safe evidence and propose a structured plan.
Separate read-only tools from material mutations.
Bind mutation arguments to an immutable digest and request explicit employee confirmation.
Execute directly only when policy permits a bounded idempotent operation; otherwise create a Workflow carrier.
Target module independently authorizes, validates, persists, audits, and returns safe outcome.
Assistant summarizes outcome and citations without becoming the source of business truth.

sections.heading: Risk controls
items: No model self-approval, provider-native tools, browser credentials, inline secrets, or hidden permissions.
Idempotency keys, optimistic revisions, timeouts, quotas, cancellation, retries only when safe, uncertain-outcome state, compensation, and reconciliation.
Human approval for destructive, financial, identity, publishing, external communication, high-cost, or otherwise material actions.
Workflow manages manual and automatic steps, pause/resume, rejection, retry, and durable recovery.

sections.heading: Evidence
items: Prompt injection, malicious retrieved content, tool confusion, argument substitution, approval replay/expiry, target denial, partial failure, duplicate execution, provider outage, workflow handoff, compensation, audit, and regression.
